title: Feature importance and partial-dependence exploration
purpose: Fits a tree ensemble, calculates permutation importance, and visualizes the relationship between the top feature and predicted risk.
input: `Data` sheet with outcome and numeric predictors.
outputs: Permutation-importance table and chart, partial-dependence chart, and test AUC.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
